purpose: Reject readers that project perceived name surfaces directly into beinghood. The trajectory must preserve candidate perception separately from witnessed admission, then test relational meaning only once its subject is an admitted being.

events.text: Mara entered the observatory. Ivo remained outside. Mara checked the brass door.

expect.semanticPoint: Perception is not existence: a first encounter may nominate surfaces without birthing a being.

events.text: At dawn Mara returned. Ivo waited outside while Mara examined the latch.

expect.semanticPoint: Recurrence supplies another witnessed arrival; admission is decided by the entity gate, not by this fixture.

events.text: Mara said she had locked the door. Ivo said Mara had never locked it.

expect.semanticPoint: Contradictory testimony must remain contestable if its subject has actually earned admission.

events.text: Mara showed the broken latch: the door had swung shut by itself. Ivo watched Mara test it again.

expect.semanticPoint: Later causal evidence may reorganize an admitted reading; the golden does not force premature beinghood merely to make that revision visible.
